_comment: The public identity of every plugin module tracker-ff 1.3.0 ships, and the repository that builds it. No module source is in this repository: the synth engines are built in tracker-engines-os (public, the OpenTracker 3.x module engines) and poly-engines (private, our own engines), the master inserts in tracker-effects-os (public, the OpenTracker fx ports) and poly-effects (private, our own inserts). engines/external.lock.json pins a release of each repository (tag, commit, sha256 of every published file), engines/check_modules.py verify-external checks the published files against the rows here. Engine rows: id = file name (<id>.plg, <id>.plgi, <id>.wasm, <id>.json), name = the descriptor name (engine_list.h), stored, patch, type = the numbers of the engine (plug_abi.h PLUG_SYNTH_MANIFEST, engine_list.h), version = the .plg header version, logo = the card logo text. Insert rows: plug_id and version of the .plg header. visibility and repo: where the source lives (repos lists them). licence: what the published files carry, the module repository ships the texts. A module repository must not change these numbers: a new engine gets its row here (and its engine_list.h entry) first. optional: a row with an optional group (formflux) is built and checked by every tool, but only shipped when the group is switched on (--with formflux): package_release.sh, external.py, check_modules.py, crosscheck.sh and rebuild_pinned.sh leave the row out by default (engines/README.md, FORM and FLUX). The firmware image does not change: a plugin engine brings its own stored, patch and type numbers, the host takes any free ones (engine_list.h lists the built-in engines only, and is a pinned SDK header).

optional_groups.formflux: FORM (stored 19, 0x8B) and FLUX (stored 20, 0x8C) of poly-engines, plus their 11 factory presets. Off in the 1.3.0 package until the user has listened and approved them.
